subject: [RFC PATCH 4/5] iomap: narrow page_mkwrite() dirtying to the faulting page

2026-09-03.patch_summary: This patch refactors the iomap code to narrow page_mkwrite() dirtying to only the faulting page, rather than the entire folio. It introduces a new function iomap_dirty_folio_range() that allows for more precise control over which parts of a folio are marked as dirty. The buffered write path and the mmap path now set the dirty range differently, with the latter setting everything due to the whole-folio coverage by iomap_dirty_folio(). The patch also updates several functions to use the new function and corrects some inconsistencies in the code.
